hooks.command: if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/bundle/cli/index.mjs" ]; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/bundle/cli/index.mjs" restore; else npx -y @tyroneross/bookmark restore; fi 2>/dev/null || true

if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/bundle/cli/index.mjs" ]; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/bundle/cli/index.mjs" context-check; else npx -y @tyroneross/bookmark context-check; fi 2>/dev/null || echo '{}'
if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/bundle/cli/index.mjs" ]; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/bundle/cli/index.mjs" precompact; else npx -y @tyroneross/bookmark precompact; fi 2>/dev/null || echo '{}'
if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/bundle/cli/index.mjs" ]; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/bundle/cli/index.mjs" stop; else npx -y @tyroneross/bookmark stop; fi 2>/dev/null || echo '{}'
